as_told.title: Native American legends of red-haired giants

plain: Native peoples of North America had legends of giants, and those giants had red hair and six fingers, according to a researcher named Tim Alberino. He tells Michels this twice in the same conversation without naming a source, and the second time he mentions only the red hair, not the six fingers. If it were so, it would hint that tales of giants were remembered on this continent as well as elsewhere.
